notes.split_half: Spearman-Brown corrected Pearson correlation of two half estimates across learners
notes.tau2: covariance of the two half estimates (true-score variance of the parameter)
notes.err_half: variance of a half estimate minus tau2 (error variance of a half estimate)
notes.phi: err_half divided by the mean model-based (sandwich) variance of a half estimate
notes.n_star: traces needed for a full-history estimate to reach the target reliability: (sigma1_sq/tau2) rho/(1-rho)
